claim_assessments.message: Both records completed 500 strict-FP32 updates on identical data and split hashes, with identical full initial-state, state-schema, paired-base, parameter-count, trainable-parameter-count, and final-state hashes. Validation MAE and RMSE are exactly equal at 0.6406513190 eV and 0.8343833076 eV; the independently recalculated absolute MAE delta is 0, latency ratio is 1.0132991280, peak-allocation ratio is 1.0, and both records state test_evaluated=false. The source gate uses F=scalar feature width+1+3+6 and skips the auxiliary solve unless some graph has more than 2F nodes. The recorded QM9 maximum is 29 nodes versus F=26, so this supports safety of the registered all-small-graph bypass, not active whitening accuracy on QM9.

The source decision function compares paired last-epoch RMSE and requires full initial-state equality for the schema-control lane. The six records have equal within-seed initial-state and paired-base hashes, equal 168823-parameter schemas, 4400 matched updates, finite metrics, and test_evaluated=false. Recalculation gives paired improvements +0.0130614770, -0.0124213597, and -0.0043692941 pK; mean -0.0012430589 pK, sample SD 0.0130258877 pK, one win, and worst regression 0.0124213597 pK. The +0.020 pK mean and two-win gates therefore fail exactly as reported.

The LBA decision records passed=false, default_change_authorized=false, and next_stage_authorized=false. conditional-followups.json implements the frozen conjunction, records QM9=true and LBA=false, lists all three follow-ups as not run, and states test_evaluated=false. The report's no-promotion, no-default-change, and conditional non-execution statements are consistent with those records and remain appropriately limited to this whitening formulation and validation harness.

limitations: This was a record, source, and method review only; no training, tests, checkpoints, or performance runs were executed.
Inspection was intentionally limited to the two summary JSON files, conditional-followups.json, report.md, and the rank-gate, frozen-mix, schema-control, and decision functions named by the packet.

The QM9 result is one seed, one target, 500 updates, and a warm random-row validation split. Because every recorded molecule is below the 2F threshold, it verifies exact bypass safety rather than behavior of an active whitened solve on small graphs.

The LBA result uses three model/order seeds and one official ID30 validation harness with last-epoch selection. It provides no test-set, cold-ligand, cold-target, pose-robustness, calibration, applicability-domain, or published-baseline conclusion.

The four reviewed artifacts and all six inspected source files matched the packet-declared SHA-256 values, but producer-entered no-test and non-execution metadata were not independently observed outside the allowed records.
